deployments_detail.use: Generative AI agentic platform for personalized customer shopping experience [Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience]
AI-driven fulfillment and order batching optimization
AI for inventory security and shrink reduction
GenAI personalization + personal shopping assistant (Google Gemini Enterprise); AI in precision marketing (84.51)
Agentic AI for Precision Marketing to unify fragmented processes
AI Creative Optimization for messaging and awareness campaigns [Claritas]
AI retail analytics for product listing optimization [Intelligence Node]

Sage: an AI virtual assistant for store associates providing a single point of access to check shift schedules, request time off, set shift availability and manage store tasks. Being expanded across the workforce.
AI-enabled dynamic batching for online order fulfillment: machine learning batches pickup/delivery orders to reduce pickup lead time and improve the store associate picking experience.

Machine-learning delivery route optimization at Ocado-powered Customer Fulfillment Centers: algorithms dynamically optimize delivery routes considering road conditions and fuel efficiency. [Ocado Smart Platform]

Intelligence Node generative-AI retail analytics on Kroger Marketplace: AI improves and enriches third-party seller product listings (content, pricing, market analytics) to boost clarity and customer experience. [Intelligence Node]

84.51 AI-generated supplier email digest: uses AI to pull retail data from 84.51's Stratum customer-behavior insights tool and auto-generate customizable insight emails for brands/suppliers. [84.51 (Stratum)]

Chefbot: AI tool (originally launched via Twitter) that recognizes ingredient/food photos and delivers personalized recipe recommendations based on items users already have, aimed at reducing food waste.

Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience powering an integrated Shopping Assistant and Meal Assistant in the Kroger app: agentic assistant that plans meals, converts recipe requests into carts, surfaces personalized offers and compares products. Nationwide rollout announced. [Google Cloud / Gemini Enterprise]

AI-driven demand forecasting and inventory optimization: Kroger generates a new demand plan for every SKU in every store nightly to optimize replenishment, reduce waste and improve on-shelf availability of fresh products.

Nvidia strategic collaboration: AI lab and demonstration center at Kroger HQ using Nvidia AI Enterprise and Omniverse to build digital-twin simulations of stores to optimize layouts, logistics and freshness initiatives. [Nvidia (AI Enterprise, Omniverse)]

84.51 data-science AI/ML model factory using DataRobot to accelerate production, deployment and interpretation of the machine-learning models powering Kroger shopper personalization and targeted offers. [DataRobot]

Instacart Cart Assistant: Kroger among first retailers to offer Instacart's AI-powered conversational shopping assistant to help customers build baskets and plan meals via natural-language interaction. [Instacart (Cart Assistant)]

Flashfood data-driven shrink/waste management: AI-supported markdown and diversion of perishable food nearing best-by dates, expanded divisionwide across the Mid-Atlantic to cut food waste. [Flashfood]
deployments_detail.value: Targeting diversion of 95% of ~166,000 tons of expected annual food waste

deployments_detail.use: Customer Experience Agent Studio (Google Cloud): AI analyzes customer calls to stores to proactively identify and resolve issues and enhance associate productivity in service interactions. [Google Cloud / Gemini Enterprise]

Everseen Visual AI at self-checkout: high-resolution cameras and computer vision detect un-scanned items and scan errors in real time, prompting customers or alerting associates to reduce shrink and accidental loss. Deployed across ~1,700 stores and expanding chainwide. [Everseen (Visual AI), Nvidia Accelerated Computing, Lenovo Edge AI servers]
deployments_detail.value: Over 75% of self-checkout errors corrected without employee intervention
